captures.title: Desktop workspace
captures.description: The genuine desktop workspace, showing the live public repository and its detail panel.
captures.descriptionYue: 真實桌面工作空間，顯示公開倉庫嘅即時資料同詳細資料面板。

captures.title: Repository details
captures.description: The authenticated repository view for Ding-Ding-Projects/material-git, captured from the running application.
captures.descriptionYue: 喺已登入嘅應用程式擷取 Ding-Ding-Projects/material-git 倉庫畫面。

captures.title: Issues: real empty state
captures.description: GitHub returned no open issues for this repository at capture time. The empty state contains no sample records.
captures.descriptionYue: 擷取嗰陣，GitHub 冇傳回呢個倉庫嘅未關閉 issue。空白狀態冇加入示範資料。

captures.title: Pull requests: real empty state
captures.description: GitHub returned no open pull requests for this repository at capture time. No fixture data is displayed.
captures.descriptionYue: 擷取嗰陣，GitHub 冇傳回呢個倉庫嘅未關閉 pull request。畫面冇顯示測試資料。

captures.title: Actions runs and jobs
captures.description: Live GitHub Actions history, with 15 returned runs and details of a successful Windows release job.
captures.descriptionYue: 即時 GitHub Actions 記錄，傳回 15 次執行，並顯示一次成功嘅 Windows 發佈工作資料。

captures.title: Release history and notes
captures.description: Live release history, with 10 returned records and the selected release’s original notes.
captures.descriptionYue: 即時版本記錄，傳回 10 個版本，並顯示所選版本嘅原始說明。

captures.title: Active account and credential source
captures.titleYue: 使用中帳戶同憑證來源
captures.description: The authenticated active account and its environment-token notice. Environment credentials take precedence over saved accounts; no credential value is visible.
captures.descriptionYue: 已驗證嘅使用中帳戶，同環境 token 來源提示。環境憑證優先於已儲存帳戶；畫面冇顯示憑證內容。

captures.title: Desktop preferences
captures.description: The desktop preferences screen, showing language, app name and playfulness controls and the available settings sections.
captures.descriptionYue: 桌面偏好設定畫面，顯示語言、應用程式名稱、趣味程度控制項同可用設定分類。

captures.title: Local source control
captures.description: The actual local Git repository opened through the native picker, with a clean worktree and explicit repository trust controls. This frame does not verify a commit operation.
captures.descriptionYue: 透過原生選擇器開啟嘅實際本機 Git 倉庫，顯示乾淨嘅工作樹同清楚嘅倉庫信任控制項。呢張畫面唔代表提交操作已驗證。
